entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected to the right department.
RETURNS! Just get me a person, this is ridiculous.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Charlie, I need to return a helmet. I've had it with this company. I've been trying to get this sorted for ages.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
It's VF88602. And don't give me any runaround. The box is unopened, still sealed. It's brand new.
Okay, one moment while I pull up order VF88602... I see the purchase of the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. Can I ask what the reason for the return is?
The color is completely wrong. It looked different online. It's hideous. I'm not wearing it. Are you going to be a problem about this? Because I will light up your reviews, I swear.
Not at all, I completely understand wanting your gear to be right, especially when it comes to safety equipment. Let me just confirm the delivery date... I see it was delivered 82 days ago.
And? What's your point? I told you the box is unopened! If you're about to tell me I'm out of luck, you better get me a manager right now!

There's no need for that, sir. You're well within the return window. For that helmet, our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. Since it's only been 82 days, I can approve this for a full refund immediately.

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending the pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
Huh. Okay. Well... fine. That's what you should have done in the first place. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
